statement.zh: Haas & Creamer 2006 将秘鲁中北部海岸约 3000–1800 BC 晚古风多谷纪念性遗址群作二手综合；「文明 crucible」为综述用语，非本条定论标签。
statement.en: Haas & Creamer 2006 synthesize Norte Chico Late Archaic multi-valley monumental sites ca. 3000–1800 BC; “crucible of civilization” is review language, not a fact-library typology verdict.
